verdict.rationale: A probe confirms docs.lithic.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with structured content describing the Lithic API, and Lithic's docs are also served as machine-readable .md files (e.g., mcp.md, auth-stream-access-asa.md) explicitly designed for AI agents/editors to consume. This directly satisfies pointing an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: independent/third-party confirmation that agents successfully consume llms.txt in practice, and no llms-full.txt or expanded agent-doc index evidenced.
